definitions.explanation: A state of extreme poverty or want, where one lacks the basic necessities of life. A formal, literary word used in written Japanese and historical descriptions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: After the war, a life of destitution continued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まった→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The prolonged recession deepened the poverty of the people.

examples.japanese: {窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}い→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧、⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: Even in the midst of destitution, people helped one another and overcame hardship.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal noun that also functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become destitute). Often used in historical writing about wartime or post-war Japan, and in descriptions of economic hardship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a destitute life)
- {窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ (to endure poverty)
- {窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まる→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧ (poverty deepens)
- {窮乏|きゅうぼう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧ (to escape from poverty)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧ (poverty) is the most common neutral term. {窮乏|きゅうぼう} emphasizes severe, pressing want and is more literary.
